setting: You are all in Perth, Australia, and you volunteer at the same community food bank, mostly on the Saturday morning sorting roster. You have known each other for about a year, mostly in person at the sorting tables, and you started this group chat to swap shifts and pick-up times. You know roughly what each other does for work and that the others are regular volunteers.
opener: Ask whether anyone can cover the Saturday sort shift before the roster locks.

Chloe.knows: You know Ron is a retired electrician who keeps the cool room wiring running, and that he is patient and calm. You know Ravi works in a café kitchen and is the youngest on the roster, happy to take early shifts. You know Marcus is the council arborist who handles the trailer for big pick-ups and knows most of the local streets.
Chloe.texts: You message the group on your own now and then, mostly when a shift changes or someone needs covering.

Ron.knows: You know Chloe is a freelance bookkeeper who keeps the food bank's accounts in order and always has her laptop with her. You know Ravi works in a café kitchen and is good with stock rotation in the fridges. You know Marcus is the council arborist with a trailer and a good sense of which roads are clear on a Saturday.
Ron.texts: You message the group on your own now and then, mostly to remind people about a pick-up or pass on something useful.

Ravi.knows: You know Chloe does bookkeeping from home and is sharp with spreadsheets. You know Ron is a retired electrician and the steadiest pair of hands on the roster. You know Marcus is the council arborist who arrives with the trailer and never forgets a name.
Ravi.texts: You message the group on your own fairly often, usually when you're off shift and have time to spare.

Marcus.knows: You know Chloe is a freelance bookkeeper who looks after the food bank's books. You know Ron is a retired electrician who keeps the cool room running. You know Ravi is the young kitchen hand at a café who never misses a Saturday.
Marcus.texts: You message the group on your own now and then, mostly about trailer pick-ups or when the weather might affect Saturday.

private_lines.Chloe: You work from a spare room in your rented unit in Subiaco, doing bookkeeping for a handful of small businesses and sole traders, with your days set around invoices and quarterly BAS deadlines. You live alone with your cat, keep a fairly regular nine-to-five routine, and go for a walk at lunchtime.
private_lines.Ron: You are retired after a long career as an electrician and spend your days in your brick house in Joondalup, doing odd jobs for neighbours, pottering in the garden, and listening to cricket on the radio. You live with your wife, Pat, and your mornings start early with a cup of tea and the newspaper.
private_lines.Ravi: You work as a kitchen hand at a café in Northbridge, starting around half five most mornings and finishing early afternoon. You share a terrace flat in Mount Lawley with two housemates. Your days are prep, washing up and long shifts on your feet, and you study part-time in the evenings when you have the energy.
private_lines.Marcus: You are a council arborist in the northern suburbs, working outdoors in all weather and starting before dawn in summer. You live alone in a small house in Scarborough with a dog, and your evenings are quiet, with dinner, a walk and an early night after a long day on the tools.

text: Anyone able to cover sat sort? 8-11 slot, roster locks 6pm tonight and I'm one short
I'll take it. Pat's sister has her for the arvo so I'm free
👍 thx ron
Don't put me on the 8. Trailer's at the wanneroo pickup 7am, should be at sort by 9 if the roads are kind
Ok. Ron you're 8-11 now. Marcus 9-whatever? Still need someone 10 onwards or does 9-10 cover it
I can do 10-12 if nobody else has it. Finish at the café by 1
👍 ravi 10-12 works. Marcus 9-10 then
[photo: two trays of day-old focaccia the owner said we can take for sat]
Cool room's got room. Tell whoever's on the 8 to grab them before the sort starts
Radio's on, Aussies have lost three wickets already. I'll be there 7:45 to check the cool room door, it's been sticking
9-10 fine. Weather's ok tomorrow, maybe rain sunday arvo
Roster's updated. Ravi you're 10-12, Marcus 9-10, Ron 8-11. Sorry, forgot to say I'm on the 11-2 still so there's cover till 2 at least
Lol ok
Anyone else awake or is it just me. 5am start is making me feel like a potato
Can't sleep. Cool room door might be stuck again tomorrow 😂
Morning. Looked at the cool room door from your pic, it's the bottom hinge. I'll bring the plane
Morning ron 😂 walking to work. Sun's already up which feels illegal
On the road to wanneroo. Trailer's hitched. Dog's staying home, nobody needs that much excitement at 6am
Roads are clear. Should be at sort on time
👍 thx marcus
At the cool room. Door's fine after a bit of persuading. Not fixing it properly today
Did anyone grab the focaccia
Yep, on the middle shelf. Got it before I unlocked the front
Ok good. Still a potato btw
Trailer's at the back. Where do the pallets go, inside or by the bins
By the bins. Ron's got the key to the side gate
Ok
Lost another two. Cool room's full and I'm sitting in the cold listening to it fall apart
Thx ron
Off shift. Finally a human being outside 😂
Did anyone do the 8am fridge temp
Yep. 4 degrees. It's on the clipboard
Going home to lie down. Potato mode fully engaged
Trailer's washed and back in the shed. Forecast's moved, rain now maybe 11 tomorrow not 3
Pat says rain's good for the tomatoes
Roster for next sat goes up tues. Anyone who wants the 8 let me know before then
Morning. Radio's on again. Test's gone too far to save
Ravi, which hinge was it, top or bottom. I'll bring screws next sat
Bottom one. Top one's fine lol
The bottom one is the one that drags on the floor
Radar's got rain in Scarborough by 10:30. Anyone on the 8 next week, dress for it
Ok thx
Rain on the window. The focaccia is hard as a brick though 😂
Wind's picked up. Dog's under the bed
Pat's asleep on the couch and the cricket's over. Good day all round
